Hi Sam — great to hear from you. Attaching a concise package to get the privacy team started (see attachments):
- dataflow_v2.pdf — annotated dataflow with PII classification layers and handling points
- short-ssq.txt — short answers to your SSQ bullets (inline excerpt below)

High-level summary:
- Ingestion points: customer endpoints -> edge sanitizer -> tokenization/pseudonymization stage -> inference runtime -> transient KV cache -> encrypted long-term artifacts only when configured for logging/audit (default: disabled).
- Subprocessors: we operate with a primary execution subprocessor (GPU clouds) and a managed logging store for audited exports. We disclose subprocessors on a rolling 30-day window; security can request expedited disclosure for SOC 2 or contractual needs.
- Transfers: default routing is region-aware; cross-border transfers enabled only when customer allows or when model variants require it. We support geofence enforcement via routing policies and short-lived SAS-style tokens for any egressed artifacts.
- KMS: customer-managed keys via KMS/HSM (bring-your-own-key) supported. We also offer split-key attestations for on-prem/private deployments.

Quick asks for your team:
1) For the DPA, do you require a specific jurisdictional annex (EU vs UK vs CA)?
2) Can you confirm whether HealthTop needs retained request/response logs for X months (if so how many)?
3) Any preferred KMS provider/mode for the initial onboarding?

Notes: the attached dataflow has two conservative enhancements we recommend: (a) an "edge sanitizer" that strips free-text PII before models see it (customer-configurable), and (b) an immutable audit blob for transfer evidence that hashes request ids and is locked with KMS.

Regards,
